sloka: किं न्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं रणगतेन हि ।न मया यद्ययं शक्यो हन्तुं वरपुरस्कृतः ।। ७.२२.४८ ॥
transliteration: kiṁ nvidānīṁ mayā śakyaṁ kartuṁ raṇagatena hi ।na mayā yadyayaṁ śakyo hantuṁ varapuraskṛtaḥ ।। 7.22.48 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, the righteous Yama then replied, "This rod has been withdrawn, for indeed, you are our powerful lord."
